Comment "SOUND" and I'll send you the paper and every defence in it 🔐🎧

Can AI hear what you type? In a lab study, an AI identified which keys were pressed from Zoom audio with 93% accuracy, and 95% from a phone 17 cm from the laptop. It cuts out each click, turns it into a spectrogram (a picture of the sound), and an image model matches the picture to the key. Even its mistakes were telling: 5 of 9 wrong guesses were the key next door.

One MacBook Pro, single keys, not whole passwords. The best defence in the paper: fake keystroke sounds added to your call audio beat white noise.

Source: Harrison, Toreini, Mehrnezhad, arXiv:2308.01074.
